title: Healing Korean Myeongnan Roe Pudding
description: A sweet and glassy-jelly dessert featuring myeongnan-roe, a type of pollock roe, known for its hangover-curing properties in Korean culture, this lacto-vegetarian friendly dish is perfect for a snack or dessert
instructions: Rinse the myeongnan-roe in cold water and drain well.
In a medium saucepan, combine the water, sugar, and agar agar powder, and bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce the heat to medium and simmer for 5 minutes, or until the agar agar is fully dissolved.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the vanilla extract and lemon juice.
Add the myeongnan-roe to the saucepan and stir gently to combine.
Pour the mixture into individual serving cups or a large mold.
Refrigerate for at least 3 hours, or until the pudding is set.
Drizzle the glaze over the pudding and serve chilled.
In a small bowl, whisk together the milk and a pinch of sugar until the sugar is dissolved.
Serve the pudding with the sweetened milk on the side.
